title: ANZAC Bell (Perth)
status_note: Called by the operator the largest swinging bell in Australia.

place.label: The Bell Tower, Barrack Square, Perth
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

timeline.event: First official ring, on the centenary of the 1918 Armistice

tiers.everyday: The ANZAC Bell in Perth weighs 6,500 kg and first rang on 11 November 2018, 100 years after the end of World War I.
tiers.student: The Bell Tower (operator: primary but not official) gives 6,500 kg, casting in Perth with gold in the alloy, installation in October 2018 and a first official ring on 11 November 2018.
